items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Sy Jenkins and his Orchestra. Sure, I remember that. ... We played a high school dance and we had our music and we rehearsed and rehearsed.

ctx.x: You were about 15 then...a Junior or Sophomore, something like that...?

Yeah. Yeah, Sophomore. Yeah, well, Sy Jenkins, he was a very energetic fellow and the whole family, they liked music. I remember his brother, he played a little trumpet, he didn't keep it up, and the other brother played drums. But Sy--I didn't realize this at the time--Sy he was a West Indian fellow and I didn't know anything about that and I knew I'd go by the house and his mother was so sweet to me and his brothers were so nice to me and they all loved music so and Sy ended up being a lieutenant in the…
weekends, you know, away from school. And then there was Howard Brockington in the band; he was my best friend in Lansing, you see. He played trumpet. And it was a nice little thing.
